t: You're on King Street in St James's, a street that runs south-west to north-east from St James's Street to St James's Square. It takes its name from Charles II, who was King of Scotland from 1649 to 1651, and then King of England, Scotland and Ireland from the restoration of the monarchy in 1660 until his death in 1685. So the street carries the name of the king who came back to the throne.
